name: debug-repository-issue
summary: Diagnose and fix a bounded repository failure through reproduction, root-cause analysis, implementation, and independent verification.
inputs: repository, branch, reported symptom, trigger, environment, and acceptance criteria
writes: diagnostic or verification report when requested
external_reads: scoped repository remotes or CI evidence
approval_gates: production, deployment, remote, database, and secret actions are separate approvals
done_when: failure is reproduced or exact missing proof is reported
root cause is supported by evidence
minimal fix and regression proof are present
independent verification passes against final artifact state
parent closure never relies on producer self-report
verification: fresh verifier checks reproduction, fix, regression, and scope
repository, symptom, trigger, environment, acceptance criteria, and approval boundary explicit
working-path comparison and falsifiable hypothesis recorded

stages.condition: use web-quality-verification only when rendered behavior is part of acceptance
verification: reproduction and acceptance criteria independently checked
final artifact identity and evidence checked; PASS closes, FIX routes to diagnose-and-fix
